title: UFO alerts in Spain: from radio calls to mobile phone surveillance
excerpt: Thousands of people looked up at the sky on the same night, summoned by radio, hoping to see something that never came. We review UFO alerts in Spain and what can be expected from these gatherings.
content:
Thousands of people looking at the sky on the same night, called together by the radio, waiting to see something that never came. The topic comes from a 2004 Milenio 3 (Cadena SER) special, which repeated the experience in 2012. On foro3d.com we review these callouts and what can be expected from them.

What was said and what is known today 👽

In 1979 the journalist Antonio José Alés called from the radio on thousands of listeners to look for an extraterrestrial brother in the sky. Nothing appeared, and critics such as the astrophysicist Javier Armentia saw it as spectacle rather than science. Today the Cuarto Milenio team presents Sky Watch Spain, a collective surveillance project from La Palma with phones and cameras. Many reported lights are explained by satellites, ball lightning or reflections.

The sky that never answers when it should 🌌

There is some irony in the fact that the most famous gathering ended with the sky in silence and thousands of sore necks. Now phones record better, but the mystery keeps playing hide-and-seek among satellites and reflections. Have you seen any light you couldn't explain? Tell us about it and tell us how you would distinguish it from a satellite.
